title: Manhattan
tagline: New York in black and white. Dessert in colour.
about: A twice-divorced comedy writer works out who he really loves.
cue: Serve dessert as the Gershwin opening fades.
faces: Book parties in the back room.
Best room in New York to argue about Bergman. Get the cheesecake. It earns a spot on my list.
Rye, sweet vermouth and bitters, stirred cold, with a cherry.
Little rounds of French bread, toasted. Ricotta with lemon peel and honey, or mushrooms, garlic and thyme under Parmesan.
Jumbo shrimp, poached and well chilled, with a sharp horseradish sauce and lemon.
Toasted bagels, cream cheese, sliced Nova, capers, red onion cut thin and fresh dill.
Wrapped to go for the bench by the bridge.
Crisp squares, maple syrup, sweet butter, berries in season.
Diced dark meat stir-fried hot with dried red peppers, soy, rice wine and black vinegar. Roasted peanuts, spring onions and rice.
Szechuan style. Sam Wo's crabs made Isaac's list.
Littlenecks opened in garlic, oil and white wine, with parsley and red pepper.
Thin scallops sautéed in butter, lemon, capers and vermouth.
Lemon and vanilla on a buttery crumb crust. Baked slow, chilled overnight.
Worth living for, the regulars say.
Bosc halves poached with cinnamon and orange peel, with cream.
